records.notes: Quotes: list bullets of the sheets rendered as ' - '. Editions compared (all opened as PDF from s7d2.scene7.com in this session). DS90GS/1109 (C10550184, O&G generator set, 2009; Spanish DS90GS-ES/1109 C10574553 identical numbers): 'Output Power Continous Duty 9450 kWe', 'Heat Rate 11 300 kJ/kWe-hr (10,710 Btu/kWe-hr)', 'Exhaust Flow 144 590 kg/hr (318,760 lb/hr)', 'Exhaust Temp. 465 C (870 F)', 'Engine efficiency: 31.9% (measured at generator terminals)', 15-stage axial compressor, 'Pressure Ratio: 16.3:1', 'Power Turbine - 2-Stage, Axial - Speed, 50-Hz Generator: 8625 rpm - Speed, 60-Hz Generator: 8570 rpm', 'Length: 14.2 m (46' 6") Width: 2.8 m (9' 2") Height: 3.8 m (12' 6") Typical Weight: 86 180 kg (190,000 lb)' (weight basis - enclosed/unenclosed, dry/wet - not stated). BIL/512 (2012): 9450 kWe, thermal efficiency 31.7 %, 14.2 x 2.8 x 3.8 m, 86 182 kg. BO&G/0819 (2019): 'Mars 90 9450' kWe. BO&G/811 (2011): 'ISO Continuous 9450 kWe', 11 300 kJ/kWe-hr, 144 590 kg/hr, 465 C; approximate unenclosed dims 14.5 x 2.8 x 3.1 m, 67 570 kg. BIL/0622 (2022) no longer lists Mars 90 among generator sets (only Mars 100); the Mars 90 GS is offered on the oil-and-gas power-generation page only. Turbomach BPHBTBM/512 (2012) table and data page print 'Electrical power: MW 9.87', 'Heat rate: kJ/kWE-hr 10'827', 'Efficiency: % 33.24', 'Exhaust gas flow: kg/s 40.16', 465 C - the power and heat rate equal the mechanical-drive shaft rating (9860 kW, 10 830 kJ/kW-hr), and the same page's correction curve reads about 9450 kWe and about 11 300 kJ/kWh at 15 C (read from the plot), so 9.87 MW is treated as an editorial error and not used. Taken: power 9450 kWe, heat rate 11 300 kJ/kWe-hr, 465 C, efficiency 31.9 % as PUBLISHED in DS90GS/1109 (3600/11300 = 31.86 agrees; BIL/512 prints 31.7). Exhaust flow: 144 590 kg/hr published; 40.16 kg/s is the unit conversion and is also printed directly by Turbomach BPHBTBM/512. Engine fields not printed in the GS sheet (GP turbine stages, GP max speed) are taken from DS90CS/1109 for the same Mars 90 engine. out_rpm = power-turbine (= gearbox input) speed; the record's former 8625 is kept as the 50 Hz value and 8570 rpm (60 Hz) added. Package dims/weight: no Mars 90 GS turbomachinery package specification could be opened, so the GS data sheet DS90GS/1109 is used (latest Mars 90 GS sheet found); alternatives in extra.pkg_alternatives. eff_pct is published, not computed. Manufacturer product pages (https://www.solarturbines.com/en_US/products/oil-and-gas-power-generation-packages/mars-90.html ; https://www.solarturbines.com/en_US/products/mechanical-drive-packages/mars-90.html) could not be opened: curl HTTP 403 Akamai 'Access Denied' (18:08 UTC 2026-11-14), plain retry at 18:11 UTC 'Empty reply from server'; WebFetch: DNS not resolved. Their values are known only from search-index extracts (GS 9450 kWe, 10,710 Btu/kWe-hr / 11,300 kJ, 870 F / 465 C; MD 13,220 hp / 9860 kW, 7655 Btu/hp-hr, 465 C) and agree with the PDF data sheets used here; the PDFs are cited as the verifying source.

records.notes: Quotes: list bullets of the sheets rendered as ' - '. Editions compared (all opened as PDF from s7d2.scene7.com in this session). DS90MD/0221 (CM20180117-55702-62251, Mars 90 Gas Turbine Mechanical Drive Package, 2021, newest): 'Output Power 9860 kW (13 220 hp)', 'Heat Rate 10 830 kJ/kW-hr (7655 Btu/hp-hr)', 'Exhaust Flow 144 585 kg/hr (318,755 lb/hr)', 'Exhaust Temp. 465 C (870 F)', 'Engine efficiency: 33.2%', 'Length: 9.1 m (30') Width: 3 m (9' 8") Height: 3.1 m (10' 3") Package Weight, Approx: 33 565 kg (74,000 lb) Driver package only, dry weight, unenclosed height'. DS90CS/0221 (2021, compressor set): same performance; package with compressor 14.2 x 3 x 3.1 m, 75 100 kg. DS90CS/1109 (C10550228, 2009; Spanish DS90CS-ES/1109): 9860 kW (printed '13.220 hp'), 10 830, 144 585 kg/hr, 465 C, 33.2 %, 15-stage, 'Pressure Ratio: 16.3:1', 'Gas Generator Turbine - 2-Stage, Reaction - Max. Speed: 11,170 rpm', 'Power Turbine - 2-Stage, Axial - Max. Speed: 9500 rpm', 9.1 x 2.8 x 3.4 m, 33 565 kg driver package only. DS90MD-ES/1109 (C10574552, Spanish mechanical-drive sheet; no English 1109 MD sheet found in C10550140-C10550290): same engine data, 'Potencia de salida 9690 kW (13,220 hp)'. BO&G/811 (2011) also prints 'ISO Continuous 9690 kW / 13,220 hp'. 13,220 hp = 9858 kW and 7655 Btu/hp-hr = 10 830 kJ/kW-hr, so 9690 kW is a misprint; 9860 kW is printed in DS90MD/0221, DS90CS/0221, DS90CS/1109, BIL/512, BIL/0622 and BO&G/0819. BIL/512 (2012) prints thermal efficiency 33.1 %; BIL/0622 (2022) 33.2 %. Taken: power 9860 kW / 13 220 hp, heat rate 10 830 kJ/kW-hr, 465 C, efficiency 33.2 % as PUBLISHED (3600/10830 = 33.24 agrees). Exhaust flow 144 585 kg/hr published; 40.16 kg/s is the unit conversion. Package: no Mars 90/100 CS/MD Turbomachinery Package Specification could be opened (DirectIndustry and cloudfront copies: proxy refuses the hosts; not on manualsdir.com), so the newest data sheet DS90MD/0221 is used for dims and weight (same as BIL/0622); 2009 sheets give 2.8 m wide x 3.4 m high (see extra.pkg_alternatives). out_rpm: only the power-turbine maximum (9500 rpm) is published; nominal/optimum speed and range left unverified. Manufacturer product pages (https://www.solarturbines.com/en_US/products/oil-and-gas-power-generation-packages/mars-90.html ; https://www.solarturbines.com/en_US/products/mechanical-drive-packages/mars-90.html) could not be opened: curl HTTP 403 Akamai 'Access Denied' (18:08 UTC 2026-11-14), plain retry at 18:11 UTC 'Empty reply from server'; WebFetch: DNS not resolved. Their values are known only from search-index extracts (GS 9450 kWe, 10,710 Btu/kWe-hr / 11,300 kJ, 870 F / 465 C; MD 13,220 hp / 9860 kW, 7655 Btu/hp-hr, 465 C) and agree with the PDF data sheets used here; the PDFs are cited as the verifying source.
